title: Hook handler sets
description: Reusable handler-type unions per event (which of command, http, mcp_tool, prompt, agent an event supports) plus the `if`-forbidden constraint. Referenced by the matcher groups under events/.

hookHandler.title: Any hook handler
hookHandler.description: One hook handler, discriminated by `type`: command, http, mcp_tool, prompt or agent.

hookHandlerNoAgent.title: Handler (no agent)
hookHandlerNoAgent.description: command, http, mcp_tool or prompt handler (PermissionRequest).

hookHandlerCommandHttpMcp.title: Handler (command, http, mcp_tool)
hookHandlerCommandHttpMcp.description: command, http or mcp_tool handler; prompt/agent are not supported on these events.

hookHandlerWithoutIf.title: Handler without `if`
hookHandlerWithoutIf.description: Constraint for events that do not evaluate `if`: a handler that sets it would never run.
